title: Russian missiles and drone hit Poland during attacks on Ukraine
summary_full: Polish PM calls strikes, which took place amid western military exercises, ‘an intentional provocation’ by MoscowTwo Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone crashed in Poland, according to officials, during Russian air attacks on Ukraine that took place amid major western military exercises by allied countries.Poland accused Moscow of “provocation” after the strikes in the south-east area of the Nato country.
